from its recent lows on September 22, pushing the BONK price up. The BONK price rose on September 22, continuing its recovery from its recent lows.

BraveNewCoin market data shows that BONK is valued at $0.000003560 with a 6.00% increase over the past 24 hours, as of the time of writing. Price traded between $0.000003280 and $0.000003690 during the same period.
The shift follows a pattern of analysts following the potential shift in resistance along X. BONK has still traded over 93% lower than its all-time high, however.
BONK Tests Daily High After 6% Recovery
Market data indicate that BONK is near the top of its 24-hour trading range.
The token reached $0.000003690 before easing to $0.000003560. Its session low stood at $0.000003280.

image.alt: BONK Tests Daily High After 6% Recovery

children: The intraday chart indicates that the price has been trading within a range of $0.0000033 and $0.0000035 for most of the session. During later trading, buying increased. Source:
That move brought BONK to higher levels earlier in the day and closer to the $0.000037 level. This level is now the closest price reference on top of the market.
The market cap of BONK is around $314.42 million. It was reported that over 87.99 trillion BONK is currently available, and over $141.67 million was reported as traded.
A significant part of the token's market capitalization is the volume figure. This represents a higher turnover in the most recent price change.
According to BraveNewCoin, BONK has reached its historical high price of $0.00005825. That November 2024 high is around 93.89% higher than the current price.
Weekly Resistance Break Draws Analyst Attention
According to this X post, the major descending resistance level of BONK is being broken with a move to the upside.

image.alt: Weekly Resistance Break Draws Analyst Attention

children: The structure shown is a result of lower highs created in the previous cycle's peak decline of the token. Price has recently bumped around this range and passed through this trendline. Source: X Via Top Gainer
The analyst attempts to break out at $0.00000341, marking BONK at the breakout.
A trendline break alone is not a confirmation of the larger projected move that's shown on the chart.
Price has yet to clear the former resistance area for the structure to remain valid.
Market data are used to give a reference for that test. BONK has already moved from $0.000003280 to as high as $0.000003690 during the latest session.
The breakout area would be held above the former descending line, and that would be a favorable situation. Your post wouldn't be as technically sound if you moved back under it.
Analyst Tracks a Monthly Recovery Setup
LongTermR takes into account a much wider time frame. The monthly BONK/USDT chart reveals a gradual decline in the price of the BONK token from its 2024 peak levels during much of 2025 and 2026.

image.alt: Analyst Tracks a Monthly Recovery Setup

children: The monthly candles have been shrinking in recent months and are now closing in on the bottom of this decline. The price is currently at a low level on the chart. Source: X via Longterm
LongTermR is projecting a big bounce in this area, with his chart showing a move of about 1,748%. This percentage is an analyst's assumption, not a price target confirmation.
The monthly time frame also reveals significant room between BONK's current price and significant trading areas.
The price action around the recent breakout area and the $0.000003690 daily high therefore focuses on the near term.

If it moves up from that level, it will continue the recent recovery trend and set a new short-term high. A loss of $0.000003280 will wipe out the current session's advance and bring BONK back down to the recent lower range.

title: BONK Price Jumps 6% as Weekly Breakout Puts Key Resistance in Focus
